name: KG duplicate cluster drain (adjudicate + keep distinct)
notes: [Added 2026-06-09; enabled daily 2026-06-09 after a one-time backlog clear of ~1400 pending duplicate_node findings] Collapses pending duplicate_node findings into connected components (union-find on the pairs) and adjudicates each in ONE kg_maintenance::duplicate_cluster_resolver (gpt-5.4) call: merge true label/coreference variants, keep recurring-event occurrences DISTINCT. Distinct verdicts are written to the durable verdict store (record_distinct_pairs_bulk) so the scanner's load_distinct_pairs short-circuit never re-compares them; true dups are merged via the revertible node_merge path (kg_merge_log / unmerge); every finding in the cluster is closed in one pass. This is the canonical duplicate_node resolver: kg_finding_backlog_drain excludes duplicate_node (exclude_finding_types) so dups go EXCLUSIVELY through this fast cluster path. Runs daily after the weekly kg_maintenance_pipeline scanner mints new candidates; limit=50 clusters/run bounds cost (a surge drains over a few days). dry_run:true + run-now writes scratch/dup_cluster_report.json for review WITHOUT mutating the KG.
